$description: Component tokens for Checkbox group. Path grammar: checkbox-group.<part>.<property>[.<orientation>|.<size>][.<state>]: colors vary by state only, the gap between options by orientation, control dimensions and type by size. Parts, options and states must exist in packages/components/specs/components/checkbox-group.spec.json. Values alias semantic tokens only (Figma library mapped colors and scales, and the additions).

row-gap.$description: Between the legend and the options when no description follows (the legend's bottom margin), and between the description, the options and the message. A description sits right under its legend (0), the two read as one heading.

gap.$description: Between two options: closer in a column than the parts around them, so the list reads as one unit.

typography.$description: Legend text: the Forms family's label sizes per control size (form.label.font-size: body.size.sm, md), medium weight, the tight line height of single lines and the normal letter spacing (Forms foundation, rule anatomy, decisions forms-text-sizes and forms-token-family).

Description text: the Forms family's description sizes per control size, smaller than the label (form.description.font-size: body.size.xs, xs), regular weight, the normal line height and the normal letter spacing (Forms foundation, rule anatomy, decisions forms-text-sizes and forms-token-family).

Message text: the Forms family's message sizes per control size, the label's (form.message.font-size: body.size.sm, md), larger than the description, so the message that says what to fix reads as easily as the field; medium weight, the normal line height and the normal letter spacing (Forms foundation, rule anatomy, decisions forms-text-sizes and forms-token-family).

column-gap.$description: Between the box and its label column.

row-gap.$description: Between an option's label and its description.

control.$description: The box of each option: a native checkbox drawn by the component, as the Checkbox's. The check is drawn in its color token.

checked-error.$description: The fill of a checked box in error: its brand fill, the role of control.background.checked, inside its error border; the border and the message carry the error (decision checked-error-fill, Forms forms-choice-error-fill). A token for two states: it applies when the box is checked and in error, and wins over control.background.checked and control.background.error (packages/tokens/AGENTS.md, Which token applies).

error.$description: The fill of an unchecked box in error, inside its error border, at rest and on hover alike: the subtle error background, as a field in error (Forms foundation, decisions forms-severity-fill and forms-choice-error-fill); a checked box keeps its brand fill (control.background.checked-error). The border and the message carry the error, the tint is not the cue.

border-color.$description: The border at rest keeps global.border.accent.neutral.default, an override of the Forms family's default (form.control.border-color.default, the field family's base neutral border) until this control's own refinement (decision form-family-aliases).

color.$description: Color of the check mark when checked.

severity-icon.$description: The severity icon, a glyph of the icon font, at the start of the message (severityIcon message; a choice control draws none after its box, Forms decision forms-severity-icon-placement; size and color, forms-severity-icon-size, -color). Only the font, the size, the gap and the color are tokenized.

message.$description: At the start of the message: the Icon's size next to 14 and 16 px body text (16 px).
Between the icon and the message text.

color.$description: The on-base icon role of the severity: the icon sits on the surface, beside the control or in the message, and takes the message text's color.

mark.$description: The required mark, "(optional)" or "(required)" at the end of the label (markedFields; decision mark-style).

typography.$description: The legend's typography in the regular weight: the mark is the legend's size, regular (Forms decision forms-mark-style).

asterisk.$description: Android and Windows only: the asterisk of a required group, in place of the mark (Forms decision forms-asterisk-style). It takes the legend's typography (legend.typography.*). Neither the web reference rendering nor the Figma component draws it.

default.$description: The error message's and the error icon's red.

margin-inline-start.$description: Between the label and the asterisk, with no word space.
